Sebi Considers Margin Changes for Longer-Dated Derivatives

The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) is considering a review of margin requirements for longer-dated derivatives contracts. Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that the regulator is examining the possibility of lowering margins for these contracts. This potential move aims to broaden India's equity derivatives market beyond short-term index options and support deeper markets, while Sebi also addresses high retail losses in futures and options (F&O) and speculative short-term trading.
